Cheerful month cheers for the arrivals team
A month with handover notes in mind
Smooth checks, steady hands

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is asking everyone to stay alert and keep the ledger clear as companion bookings move through the system. <<FACT F008>> Any gap in handover can slow a pet's path, so the crew must verify notes, share updates fast, and keep service changes visible for the cabin team.

The daily round-up also reminds staff to watch lounge flow, crate condition, and passenger reassurance with equal care. <<FACT F024>> That simple discipline helps protect comfort, supports the journey, and keeps every animal moving with calm attention.
